summary: Gamehaus Holdings Inc., a Shanghai-based foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K containing notice and proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting scheduled November 27, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. Eastern Time. The sole proposal is a routine 10-for-1 share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares (par value rising from US$0.0001 to US$0.001), reducing authorized capital to 90,000,000 Class A and 10,000,000 Class B shares, with fractional shares rounded up and board discretion over market effective date. Conditioned on Class B Consent; no special-situation event.
